topic: Online learning is becoming common. Why is this happening and is this a positive development?

turns.text: 在线学习越来越常见，因为越来越多人在网上学习。

seed.draft: Online lessons let me study after work. I think this is a positive change.

issue.title: 解释自己的判断
issue.why: 本轮只讨论学生自己的判断、理由和例子，不添加新的题目内容。
issue.hintL1: 解释原因、后果或自己的观察。
